name: learning
description: Skills for learning a topic in a format the reader absorbs, and for practicing code by hand. teach-like-stackoverflow answers a programming or computer-science question as a mock Stack Overflow thread on one HTML page: an asker's real error, an accepted answer with short working code and a traced example, follow-up comments, and further answers that each solve it a different way. Every code block is run before it goes on the page. code-practice has the user re-implement one slice of a merged change on a practice branch, with failing tests and graded hints but no implementation code from the agent, then critiques their design, data structures, time and memory complexity against the merged version.
